Predict host susceptibility probabilities from logistic regression coefficients

Source: R/predict_phylopred_probability.R
predict_phylopred_probability.Rd

Applies a logit function using intercept and slope coefficients to a vector of phylogenetic distances. Accepts a numeric vector, a phylopred_model, or a phylopred_bootstrap object.

Usage

predict_phylopred_probability(coef, dist)

Arguments

coef

A named numeric vector with elements "intercept" and "slope", OR a phylopred_model object, OR a phylopred_bootstrap object (in which case the bootstrap summary means are used). An unnamed vector of length >= 2 is interpreted as c(intercept, slope).

dist

A numeric vector of phylogenetic distances.

Value

A named numeric vector of predicted probabilities of the same length as dist.

See also

fit_phylopred_model

Examples

inc <- prepare_incidence_matrix(beetleTreeInteractions)
al  <- align_phylopred_inputs(inc, phy_dist)
model <- fit_phylopred_model(al$incidence, al$phydist, seed = 42)
dist_vec <- seq(0, max(al$phydist), length.out = 50)
predict_phylopred_probability(model, dist_vec)
